paragraphs.text: Rin and Seri are a Dog and a Cat who travel the wilderness of their home plane together.

They make an excellent team: the dog Rin herds the prey while the cat Seri moves in to finish it off. Both the pets were abandoned by their owners at a young age, and lived alone for years before they met. At first they were wary of each other, but from now on they will never be parted.
